# Dr. Ali Alheneiti — Cosmetic Dentistry, Amman, Jordan

> A bilingual (Arabic/English) cosmetic dentistry clinic in Amman, Jordan, led by
> Dr. Ali Alheneiti, specializing in natural-looking dental veneers, Hollywood Smile
> design, dental implants, teeth whitening, orthodontics, and gummy smile treatment.

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Dr. Ali Alheneiti, cosmetic dentist (Amman, Jordan)
- Location: Amman, 4th Circle, next to the French Embassy
- Contact: WhatsApp +962 79 016 9494 (https://wa.me/962790169494)
- Languages: Arabic, English
- Serves: Jordan, GCC, and Europe (dental tourism)
